name: a reused refresh token revokes the entire session family
description: The security-critical branch of ADR-0002. Refresh tokens rotate on every use; presenting an already-used one means it leaked, so the whole family is revoked and the holder of the CURRENT token is logged out too. That last part is the point — a thief and a victim cannot be told apart, so both are stopped.

steps._step: Rotate once. The token from step 1 is now spent.

sessions._note: Two rows, one family. The first is marked used, the successor is live.

steps._step: Replay the spent token — this is the leak signal.

sessions._note: EVERY row in the family is revoked, including the one nobody misused.

steps._step: The legitimate holder of the current token is logged out as collateral. Deliberate — we cannot distinguish them from the thief.
